<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak at m/z 193 with progressively smaller M+1, M+2, etc., matching the expected 13C distribution for a molecule containing several carbons and lacking the characteristic 2:1 or 1:1 ratios of Cl, Br, S, etc.—the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
